label: Small terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 20x20x15 cm with a handmade 3D background. Volume: 6.0 liters, horizontal format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: This is a low terrarium with a square base: 20x20 cm of floor, or 400 cm², and just 15 cm of height. The volume is about 6 liters. The low height is deliberate, because it is made for small ground-dwelling animals that a fall from height can harm.

Smaller ground-dwelling tarantulas have enough floor here for a hide and a water dish, and a low ceiling they cannot seriously fall from. A juvenile leopard gecko can spend its first weeks in it, while it finds food easily. For mantises and jumping spiders 15 cm of height is too little, so taller models with the same base suit them better. A 3D background closes off the back.

When the animal grows, the next models for ground species are the 30x20x25 and 35x25x20. If you need the same height with a larger base, for example 30x30x15, we build it to order. We ship it by courier anywhere in Serbia. A non-standard size takes 7 to 14 days to build, and you choose the film from 34 patterns.
